researchIterations.scope: Whole-trail overview and initial section inventory
researchIterations.summary: Established official trail identity, 10-stage order, Naturkartan GPX availability, OSM relation inventory and overview caveats before section-level research.
Confirmed official labels, 10 km/2.5 hours/Medel baseline, Hestrafors IF access text, Abborrsjön/Slätthult rest-area text, and source contradictions.
Audited Naturkartan GPX/API, OSM relation 5604822, Waymarked Trails, endpoint continuity and coordinate gaps.
Collected Abborrsjön/Slätthult shelter, toilet, fireplace and waste candidates; endpoint/access clusters; and off-route suppressions.
Established Holmens bro/line 122 as weak start transit, Olsfors/Bråtes bro/line 402 as end-area transit, and Hestrafors IF plus Omegastugan as separate access clusters.
Collected AllTrails 2025-2026 signals, Wikiloc longer user trace, older Utsidan/E1 shelter context, Trailforks endpoint-area wetness clues and older ultrarunning signage notes.
Collected QA warning, fire-ban authority, no confirmed protected-area intersection, dog/private-land notes, Abborrsjön shelter currentness conflict and water unreliability.

Merged lane findings into this section research JSON and marked section ready for normalization with caveats, not runtime import. No second agent batch needed because weak areas are narrow verification questions rather than missing source categories.

importReadiness.summary: Section 2 has enough official source, GPX/OSM geometry, commute/access, facilities, rules and field-report evidence for a normalization pass. It is not ready for direct runtime import because access-cluster semantics, Abborrsjön shelter/toilet currentness, potable-water absence and trail-wide QA caveats remain.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 2 links Hestrafors IF/Brandshed with IK Omega near Olsfors through mostly forested, fairly hilly terrain on a mix of gravel road, paths and forest roads. The main rest stop is Rastplats Slätthult by Abborrsjön, where sources identify a shelter, grill/fireplace, waste bin and likely toilet, but the shelter's current restoration/new-build status should be verified. Public transport is weak at the Hestrafors end; Olsfors and Bråtes bro are more useful access points for the IK Omega/Omegastugan side.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 2 GPX as primary geometry in official Hestrafors/Brandshed-to-IK-Omega direction; use OSM relation 5604822 as cross-check only and reverse OSM if used directly.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use GPX endpoints for route geometry. Model Hestrafors IF/Bollevi as start access cluster about 350-400 m north of the route line. Model Omegastugan/Olsfors/Start etapp 3 as lower access metadata about 1.1 km from the IK Omega route endpoint.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Import Abborrsjön/Slätthult shelter, toilet, fireplace and waste only with currentness caveats and no drinking-water claim.
Model Hestrafors IF/Bollevi, IK Omega/Omegastugan and Bråtes bro/Olsfors as access/commute metadata rather than ordinary trail facilities.
